title: Iran says will not 'bow' to pressure amid US nuclear talks as anti-govt protests reported in Tehran
summary: ⁠President ​Masoud Pezeshkian said on ​Saturday that Iran "will not ​bow" ‌to pressure from world powers amid nuclear talks with the US. Meanwhile, Iranian students chanted anti-government slogans at rallies for the thousands killed during last month's demonstrations, local and diaspora media reported.
